title: Validity-Aware AI: An Entropy-Bounded Architecture for Regime-Sensitive Inference
abstract: Proposes an AI architecture for pre-inference entropy measurement and regime classification across three layers (L1/L2/L3). Reframes hallucination as a protocol violation rather than a stochastic error. The architecture ensures no confident claims are made outside an empirically valid regime.

efc_context.regime_relevance: AI architecture enforcing regime-bounded validity for inference and response generation

key_results: Pre-inference entropy measurement architecture with L1/L2/L3 regime classification
Hallucination reframed as protocol violation rather than stochastic error
No confident claims outside empirically valid regime boundary
Entropy-bounded response protocols for regime-sensitive AI systems
